text: DIAGNOSTICS only (parse_help.rs): eleven parse-tier E0000 errors (`is`, an unnamed `{ k: v }` record, `[x; n]`, a typed literal `0i64`, `fn(..)` as a value, a nested fn item, a lone `{` in a string, `type` in a fn, `type X {`, `**`, `*x`) now carry a help line, each keyed on the observed message plus a source shape. Diagnostic codes, messages, line/col and exit codes are unchanged; the parser, checker and interpreter are not touched, so no program's pass/fail moves.
